headline: Bills at Ravens: Undefeated Buffalo faces Lamar Jackson on Sunday Night Football
whyCareReason: Josh Allen's red-hot 3-0 Bills travel to M&T Bank Stadium to face two-time MVP Lamar Jackson and Derrick Henry in a premier AFC heavyweight showdown.
teaser: Sunday 4 October, 20:20 ET at M&T Bank Stadium. Josh Allen and Lamar Jackson renew their rivalry in the biggest regular-season clash of Week 4.
story:
Why this one matters: Week 4's Sunday Night Football brings together the two most dynamic dual-threat quarterbacks of this generation as the undefeated Buffalo Bills collide with the Baltimore Ravens.

Buffalo enters M&T Bank Stadium in blistering form at 3-0, averaging a league-best 34.3 points per contest. Josh Allen has been virtually unstoppable, accounting for 11 total touchdowns without turning the ball over. With James Cook providing balance in the backfield, Joe Brady's offense has overwhelmed opponents.

For Baltimore, Sunday night represents a critical proving ground. Lamar Jackson and Derrick Henry present the most punishing ground game in the AFC, capable of controlling the clock and exhausting opposing defenses. Following San Francisco's 24-20 thriller over the Rams on Thursday night, Baltimore vs Buffalo stands as the centerpiece of Week 4.
stakes: Buffalo can cement their status as AFC favorites by moving to 4-0, while Baltimore aims to climb back to .500 with a statement victory.
rivalryAngle: Allen vs Jackson is tied 3-3 all-time, representing the defining quarterback rivalry of the modern AFC alongside Mahomes.
